title: Avis n° 006-05-2025 relatif à la période transitoire de mise en conformité aux dispositions de l'Instruction n° 001-01-2024 du 23 janvier 2024 relative aux services de paiement dans l'UMOA
why: Conduct and complaints rules for payment services in force across UMOA incl. Niger (rules in force).

title: Instruction N°001-01-2024 relative aux services de paiement dans l'UMOA
why: Fee disclosure, complaints within 7 working days, escalation to Commission Bancaire or national OQSF mediation (rules, redress).

title: Vers une meilleure protection des consommateurs au Niger
why: States Niger texts do not cover digital financial services and the OQSF-NE is being made operational (rules gap, redress).

title: Risques des services financiers numériques et amélioration de la protection des consommateurs
why: BCEAO sets out its client-protection rules for e-money and a harmonised framework in preparation (rules draft, redress).

title: Rapport semestriel de surveillance des moyens et services de paiement à fin décembre 2021
why: E-money issuers received 2.65 million complaints in the period; issuers enjoined to fix non-compliance (enforcement, complaint figures).

title: Consumer protection for digital financial services
why: BCEAO area has no common consumer-protection authority; only Senegal and Cote d'Ivoire have an observatoire (redress absence).
